description: This file declares the SurfaceImpl class and related structures for the ANGLE graphics library, specifically for rendering surfaces in the egl:: namespace. It includes method declarations for surface management, buffer swapping, and timestamp querying.

classes.name: SurfaceImpl
classes.description: Abstract class representing a rendering surface in ANGLE, providing interface methods for surface operations such as initialization, buffer swapping, and timestamp management.

methods.name: SurfaceImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the surface with a given surface state.

methods.name: ~SurfaceImpl
methods.description: Destructor for SurfaceImpl.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Virtual method to destroy the surface, default implementation does nothing.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Pure virtual method to initialize the surface with a display.

methods.name: createDefaultFramebuffer
methods.description: Pure virtual method to create a default framebuffer for the surface.

methods.name: makeCurrent
methods.description: Method to make the surface current in the given context.

methods.name: unMakeCurrent
methods.description: Method to unbind the surface from the current context.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Pure virtual method to swap buffers.

methods.name: swapWithDamage
methods.description: Method to swap buffers with damage rects.

methods.name: swapWithFrameToken
methods.description: Method to swap buffers with a frame token.

methods.name: postSubBuffer
methods.description: Pure virtual method to post a sub-region of the buffer.

methods.name: setPresentationTime
methods.description: Method to set presentation timestamp.

methods.name: querySurfacePointerANGLE
methods.description: Pure virtual method to query surface pointer attributes.

methods.name: bindTexImage
methods.description: Pure virtual method to bind a texture image to the surface.

methods.name: releaseTexImage
methods.description: Pure virtual method to release a texture image from the surface.

methods.name: getSyncValues
methods.description: Pure virtual method to get synchronization values.

methods.name: setSwapInterval
methods.description: Method to set the swap interval.

methods.name: setFixedWidth
methods.description: Method to set a fixed width for the surface.

methods.name: setFixedHeight
methods.description: Method to set a fixed height for the surface.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Pure virtual method to get surface width.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Pure virtual method to get surface height.

methods.name: isPostSubBufferSupported
methods.description: Pure virtual method to check if post sub-buffer is supported.

methods.name: getSwapBehavior
methods.description: Pure virtual method to get swap behavior.

methods.name: getD3DTextureColorFormat
methods.description: Method to query color format from D3D textures.

methods.name: setTimestampsEnabled
methods.description: Method to enable or disable timestamp collection.

methods.name: getSupportedCompositorTimings
methods.description: Method to get supported compositor timings.

methods.name: getCompositorTiming
methods.description: Method to get specific compositor timing values.

methods.name: getNextFrameId
methods.description: Method to retrieve the next frame ID.

methods.name: getSupportedTimestamps
methods.description: Method to get supported timestamps.

methods.name: getFrameTimestamps
methods.description: Method to get timestamps for a specific frame.
